config.experiment: Locked Round6L2zero2021 selection: fixed features, tree counts and weights; native2022 confirmation, no earlystopping.

sampling_rule: Full weekly inputs, then hour % stride == (Run No + seed) % stride; all evaluation hours retained.
training_diagnostic_scope: All 168 hours of historical training cases; sampled_training uses the fitted stride4 subset. In-sample scores with overlapping weeks are optimistic.
